info.name: CV Builder API
info.description: Complete API collection for the CV Builder application: Authentication, CVs, Cover Letters, Templates, and Cover-Letter HTML preview. **Updated 2026-07-25** — aligned with the Cover Letter API updates: - Full Cover Letter CRUD + print + templates under `/api/v1/cover-letters` - `GET /cover-letters/templates` returns a full `preview` URL (use as-is in ``) - `POST /cover-letters/print` returns JSON `{ url }` (open the URL, do NOT expect a PDF body) - New web preview route `GET /cover-letter/{id}?template_id=…` for iframe/WebView - Languages: `en`, `ar`, `tr` All auth-protected requests use a Bearer token that is auto-extracted from `POST Login` / `POST Register` and stored in the `auth_token` environment variable. The collection's pre-request script automatically injects `Authorization: Bearer {auth_token}` when the variable is set.

request.description: Create a new CV. When authenticated, the CV is saved to the user and `result.id` is auto-stored as `cv_id`. Top-level fields: `name` (required), `language` (default `en`), `sections_order`, `user_data`.

Unauthenticated user with `template_id`: the API saves the profile AND returns `result.url` to the generated PDF. No Bearer token is sent. (Behavior since the v2 refactor: the response is always JSON, never a raw PDF body.)
Update a CV you own. All fields optional; same shape as create. Auth required.
Soft delete a CV you own. Auth required.
Generate PDF for an existing CV profile. Response is JSON `{ success, message, result: { url } }`. Open `result.url` in a browser or download manager to grab the PDF.
Generate a PDF for CV data without an existing profile. `template_id` is required; `user_data` follows the same shape as Create. Response is JSON `{ result: { url } }`.

Public. Returns all active cover-letter templates. Each entry has `id`, `name` (`ats-classic` / `professional`), `preview` (absolute URL — use directly in ``), `description`, `is_default`. Prefer `is_default: true` when nothing is selected yet.
Get the authenticated user's cover letters. Auth required.

request.description:
Create a new cover letter. Optional Bearer token: if present, the letter is owned by that user; if absent, the `user_id` field can be used to associate it manually. The new `result.id` is auto-stored as `cover_letter_id`.

Fields: `name` (required, max 255), `language` (default `en`, one of `en`/`ar`/`tr`), `cover_letter_template_id` (optional, must exist), `sections_order` (optional string[]), `user_data` (optional, see schema in the docs).
Update a cover letter you own. All fields optional; same shape as create. Auth required.
Soft delete a cover letter you own. Auth required.

**Option A — from an existing record.** Generate a PDF for a saved cover letter. Response is JSON `{ success, message, result: { url } }`. Open `result.url` to download / preview the PDF (do NOT expect a raw PDF body). Locale follows the saved `language`.

request.description: **Option B — ad-hoc data, no saved letter.** `template_id` is required and `user_data` must contain at least `firstName` + `lastName`. Response is JSON `{ result: { url } }`. Useful for "preview before save" flows.

query.description: Optional. Falls back to the letter's saved template, then the default active template.

request.description: **Web preview route (no `/api` prefix).** Returns an HTML page that renders the cover letter with the chosen template — load it in an iframe / WebView to preview before or after saving. Locale follows the cover letter's `language`. (Route: `routes/web.php` → `CoverLetterPreviewController@preview`.)
Public. Returns all active CV templates. Each entry has `id`, `name`, `type`, `preview_url` and other metadata. Use the `id` as `template_id` for `POST /cvs/print`.
